name: After Everything
source:
Noa has been lonely for a long time.


The virus killed anyone she considered family, and even zombies became scarce, leaving behind a desolate world.

While wandering around with no purpose, she ends up meeting a diverse group of survivors that still hold onto hope... could they spark in her a reason to keep going?

[From [url=https://naedoesgames.itch.io/after-everything]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
诺亚已经孤独了很长一段时间。


病毒杀死了她认为是家人的任何人，甚至僵尸也变得稀少，留下了一个荒凉的世界。

当她漫无目的地闲逛时，她最终遇到了一群仍然抱有希望的多元化幸存者……他们能否激发她继续前进的理由？

[来自[url=https://naedoesgames.itch.io/after-everything]itch.io[/url]]
